description: Create an Endpoint Route Table for a gateway type (routes traffic arriving from that gateway). Use dryRun=true to preview.

dryRun.description: If true, returns a preview without actually creating the resource

endpointRouteTableName.description: Name (3-30 chars; lowercase letters, digits, '-'; starts with a letter). Auto-assigned if omitted

endpointRouteTableTypeCode.description: Table type (only types enabled for the account/region): IGW (Internet Gateway) | VGW (Virtual Private Gateway) | TRANSITVPCCONNECT (Transit VPC Connect) | POGW (Public Onpremise Gateway) | OGW (Onpremise Gateway) | NATGW (NAT Gateway)

name: ncloud_create_endpoint_route_table
